detailed_descriptions.en: In Firehawk, you are a force of nature, pilot advanced FPV combat drones through intense missions where split-second decisions matter. Death sends you back to base - but your tech, skills, and power grow with every run. REAL FPV DRONE COMBAT A real FPV drone. With guns. Firehawk runs on true drone physics, so every dive, every corner, and every kill is flown by hand. 10-player PvP. 2 to 4 player co-op. Roguelite runs, endless survival, and time trials solo. Start as a rookie. Crash a lot. Become an ace. 10-PLAYER PVP Up to 10 pilots, no aim assist, no autopilot. Every kill is throttle, angle, and timing. Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Bounty Hunter, Domination, and Capture the Flag. CO-OP SURVIVAL Endless waves, scaled for 2 to 4 pilots. Turrets, hacker drones, elite squadrons, and bosses that solo players have been cursing since launch. Friendly fire is off, so shoot freely. SOLO ROGUELITE, SURVIVAL AND TIME TRIALS The roguelike campaign: fly missions, die, expand your base, come back stronger, and push toward a final boss that will make you rethink every approach angle you know. Time Trial: fixed maps, fixed enemies, your unlocked drones, and a leaderboard to climb. TRUE DRONE PHYSICS A custom physics engine models thrust at every rotor, so the drone carries momentum, drifts, and never brakes by magic. Two control modes: Arcade for mouse and keyboard or gamepad, and Realistic , full acro for FPV radios and gamepads, with Betaflight rates and your actual rates supported. Autofire triggers when your crosshair crosses a target, so a two-stick radio is all you need; switch to manual fire if you'd rather pull the trigger yourself. EARN YOUR ARSENAL 23 drones across light, medium, and heavy classes. None is stronger than the others; pick the one that flies the way you like. XP unlocks new drones and adds new weapons to the drop pool, and everything you earn is yours in every mode. 42 weapons, 25 gadgets, 44 enemy types, 6 maps from open islands and deserts to tight industrial interiors and night ops. FEATURES Online PvP for up to 10 players: Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Bounty Hunter, Domination, Capture the Flag Online co-op endless survival for 2 to 4 players Single-player roguelike campaign with persistent base progression Time Trial with Steam Leaderboards Custom drone physics engine with Betaflight and Actual rate support Arcade and Realistic (acro) control modes Autofire and manual fire FPV radio, gamepad, and mouse and keyboard support 23 drones, 42 weapons, 25 gadgets, 44 enemy types including 7 bosses, 6 maps Windows and macOS, all modes ROADMAP Multiplayer is in Beta and shaped by what pilots actually play. Matchmaking and a competitive mode are next. Feedback goes straight into the build.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
In Firehawk, you are a force of nature, pilot advanced FPV combat drones through intense missions where split-second decisions matter. Death sends you back to base - but your tech, skills, and power grow with every run.

REAL FPV DRONE COMBAT

A real FPV drone. With guns. Firehawk runs on true drone physics, so every dive, every corner, and every kill is flown by hand.

10-player PvP. 2 to 4 player co-op. Roguelite runs, endless survival, and time trials solo. Start as a rookie. Crash a lot. Become an ace.

10-PLAYER PVP

Up to 10 pilots, no aim assist, no autopilot. Every kill is throttle, angle, and timing. Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Bounty Hunter, Domination, and Capture the Flag.

CO-OP SURVIVAL

Endless waves, scaled for 2 to 4 pilots. Turrets, hacker drones, elite squadrons, and bosses that solo players have been cursing since launch. Friendly fire is off, so shoot freely.

SOLO ROGUELITE, SURVIVAL AND TIME TRIALS

The roguelike campaign: fly missions, die, expand your base, come back stronger, and push toward a final boss that will make you rethink every approach angle you know. Time Trial: fixed maps, fixed enemies, your unlocked drones, and a leaderboard to climb.

TRUE DRONE PHYSICS

A custom physics engine models thrust at every rotor, so the drone carries momentum, drifts, and never brakes by magic. Two control modes: Arcade for mouse and keyboard or gamepad, and Realistic, full acro for FPV radios and gamepads, with Betaflight rates and your actual rates supported. Autofire triggers when your crosshair crosses a target, so a two-stick radio is all you need; switch to manual fire if you'd rather pull the trigger yourself.

EARN YOUR ARSENAL

23 drones across light, medium, and heavy classes. None is stronger than the others; pick the one that flies the way you like. XP unlocks new drones and adds new weapons to the drop pool, and everything you earn is yours in every mode. 42 weapons, 25 gadgets, 44 enemy types, 6 maps from open islands and deserts to tight industrial interiors and night ops.

FEATURES

  • Online PvP for up to 10 players: Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Bounty Hunter, Domination, Capture the Flag

  • Online co-op endless survival for 2 to 4 players

  • Single-player roguelike campaign with persistent base progression

  • Time Trial with Steam Leaderboards

  • Custom drone physics engine with Betaflight and Actual rate support

  • Arcade and Realistic (acro) control modes

  • Autofire and manual fire

  • FPV radio, gamepad, and mouse and keyboard support

  • 23 drones, 42 weapons, 25 gadgets, 44 enemy types including 7 bosses, 6 maps

  • Windows and macOS, all modes

ROADMAP

Multiplayer is in Beta and shaped by what pilots actually play. Matchmaking and a competitive mode are next. Feedback goes straight into the build.
